title: Is Cannes mayor David Lisnard a dark horse for French presidential elections?
summary: French presidential candidate David Lisnard has surprised many by surpassing former prime ministers Edouard Philippe and Gabriel Attal in a recent voter intention pole. The mayor of Cannes is running on an ultra-liberal platform and has gained a large following on social media, but some critics say he lacks the national experience needed for the Elysée.
